findings.rationale: Indice minéral, ressource and réserve remain separate. Mise en service, qualification and réception par le client are not collapsed into exploitation. Garanties de remise en état means provision for closure/restoration obligations, not work already performed. Capacité nominale is distinct from production observée.

Manifestación mineral, recurso and reserva remain distinct. Puesta en servicio, calificación and recepción distinguish commissioning from acceptance. Garantías de rehabilitación preserves provision for future obligations; cierre de un préstamo does not imply loan repayment or completed construction.
